name: gh-transfer-pricing
description: Use this skill for Ghana transfer pricing compliance in tax year 2026 under the Transfer Pricing Regulations, 2020 (L.I. 2412) and Income Tax Act, 2015 (Act 896) as amended. It covers who is in a controlled relationship, the 25% control test, arm's length pricing, the methods, contemporaneous documentation, Master and Local files, the transfer pricing return due four months after year end, the Country-by-Country Report due twelve months after the reporting year, adjustments and penalties. Trigger on "Ghana transfer pricing", "related party Ghana", "TP return GRA", "controlled relationship", "Master file Ghana", "CbC Ghana". Rates are in gh-corporate-income-tax and withholding is in gh-cross-border.
